summary: This is a basic FastAPI web application that defines three HTTP GET endpoints. The first endpoint returns a simple greeting, the second accepts an item ID and optional query parameter, and the third accepts pagination parameters with default values.

explanations.2: Union[str, None] means the parameter can be either a string or None (nothing), allowing it to be optional.
explanations.11: The q parameter has a default value of None, so callers don't have to provide it—if they don't, it will be None.
explanations.15: These parameters have default values (skip defaults to 0, limit to 10), so they're optional query parameters that the caller can override if needed.
